page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by KVM virtualization. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it provides 32 dedicated vCPUs matched with 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. Compute acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, providing a cumulative total of 16 GB VRAM across both accelerators.

The instance relies exclusively on network-attached storage, having no local storage bundled. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 6 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. Without integrated local solid-state drives, storage performance depends entirely on remote block storage solutions configured via the platform.

Hardware tradeoffs focus on the pairing of mature NVIDIA P4 GPUs with substantial dedicated CPU and memory resources. While lacking modern high-density tensor cores, the dual-GPU layout offers a balanced, cost-effective resource tier for workloads that do not justify enterprise accelerator footprints. Primary operational fits include machine learning inference pipelines, video transcoding, visual rendering, and light multi-threaded compute workloads requiring dedicated GPU acceleration.
